about_the_game:
Space Lattice is a single player virtual reality puzzle game where you stack blocks into a giant 3D lattice in space. Endless blocks will fall at you from above at increasing rates. Complete rows, columns, or levels to clear the blocks in all three dimensions. If you drop a block or do not catch a block fast enough then the block will appear in your pocket for later use. Be careful because once your pockets are full the game will end.

You will need to use your hands to twist the held block into position in the 3D lattice (3D grid).
Meet the blocks:




You will need to strategically position yourself around the 3D lattice for optimal block placement OR Grab the 3D lattice and rotate it instead. Just sit in your favorite chair for a chill experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR with Valve Index, WMR Headsets, Oculus Quest, Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3 with Steam Link, most headsets with motion controllers
  • Additional Notes: Tracked Controller Support, Room Scale or Sitting
